main.description: Bind the invitation a `?claim=<token>` link names to the caller. This is how a rostered member, known only by an email address, becomes a DID. It binds and nothing more: voting rights stay as an owner set them. Repeating a claim the caller already made succeeds.

context_id.description: The context the caller now belongs to.

errors.name: InvalidClaim
errors.description: The token is unknown or no longer valid.

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.description: Someone else has claimed this invitation.

errors.name: AlreadyMember
errors.description: The caller already holds a membership of that context.
